welcome.caption: Sign in with the registered email and password. The public catalogue link is available without signing in.
Use the library selector at the top. RBGN is an independent library; RBCET and RBMI share the central library.

access.caption: Settings contains the librarian assignment and access controls. Only the administrator manages roles and holiday calendars.

passwords.caption: Legacy initial-password setup is shown here. New invitation users choose their own password without an initial-password field; existing account passwords remain unchanged.
Forgot password asks for the registered email. Request the message and use the newest recovery link; never share passwords.

overview.caption: Check the selected library, today’s availability, collection totals, active loans, overdue books and assessed fine balance.

availability.caption: Choose the date, availability and reason. An unavailable date is excluded from fines only for the selected library.

patrons.caption: Search queries the full patron register. Previous / Next browse database pages; Bulk students and Bulk faculty provide invitation-based account setup.
For a faculty membership, choose Faculty and the institute. The patron code identifies the borrowing record.

imports.caption: Download the faculty template, fill the membership fields and provide a unique real email. New accounts receive invitation emails; legacy password columns are ignored.
Student upload uses its own template. Review the preview and approval checkbox; a real unique email is needed for a new login.
Book CSV upload adds physical copies. Review accessions and barcodes before approving the transactional batch.

catalogue.caption: The catalogue separates bibliographic titles from copies. Use Add title, View copies and Bulk upload as appropriate.

marc.caption: The MARC21 / MARCXML import panel appears above the catalogue. Select UTF-8 MARC, review the mapped copies and confirm the import.

circulation.caption: Active loans show patron, accession, due date and actions. Check the issuing library before issue or return.
Scan the copy barcode/accession and enter the patron code. The issuing library is shown and recorded.
After a sample overdue return, the notice shows the fine assessed and the loan moves to Returned loans.
Open Receipt for a returned loan. Verify patron, book, library and fine, then use Print receipt if needed.

holds.caption: The hold queue is scoped to this library. Place hold opens the title and patron form.
Select the bibliographic title and enter the patron code. The system checks the queue and borrowing eligibility.

fines.caption: A sample assessed fine appears after an overdue return. Review assessed, paid, waived and outstanding amounts.
Payment records money already collected at the desk. Enter the amount and receipt/reference; waivers need an approval reason.

acquisitions.caption: Manage budgets, funds, baskets and purchase orders within the selected library.
Choose the vendor, title, optional fund/basket, quantity and invoice reference before saving the order.

authorities.caption: Authority control standardizes names and subjects. Use Add authority, then Link title to connect records.
Choose the authority type, enter its heading and add useful variants or notes.

lists.caption: Create a reading list, choose its visibility and add titles. Private lists remain restricted to their owner.

serials.caption: Add subscription begins the journal/periodical workflow; predicted issues appear after the subscription is saved.
Enter the journal title, frequency, start date and issue count. Review predictions and mark issues received or missing.

search.caption: Combine bibliographic, item-status and checkout filters. The result grid and CSV export reflect the chosen criteria.

opac.caption: Title cards show exact availability counts with limited copy previews. Browse physical copies and Previous / Next controls load bounded pages.

stock.caption: Start session creates an inventory snapshot. Existing sessions later show scan progress and discrepancies.
Give the stock-verification session a clear name, start it, then scan copies against that snapshot.

reports.caption: Each standard report offers View report, Export CSV and Export PDF. Choose the library before opening a report.
The on-screen viewer shows the matching count, search, rows per page and export controls. Exports include every matching row, not just this page.
A saved circulation report shows its date limits and results inside the same viewer. It can also be exported as PDF or CSV.

administration.caption: Audit trail records the operator, action, time and non-secret details. Search or expand entries for an authorized review.
In Settings, download the holiday template and upload approved dates for the selected library. RBGN can have its own list.
Add additional holiday records an unplanned closure. Only the administrator can save it; the date is excluded from fines.

deployment.caption: After deployment, verify the library selector and connection indicator. This screenshot is a sample workspace; live mode shows Supabase connected.

backup.caption: Register exports support authorized record review. Follow the backup chapter for database backups; CSV exports are not a complete database backup.

troubleshooting.caption: For import errors, check the template headers, TRUE/FALSE, ISO expiry dates and institute assignment before retrying.
